notes: This is an intentionally empty preparation file, not an approved production inventory.
Do not infer Austrian PLZ coverage or generate a complete sequence from examples or postcode patterns.
Include geographic PLZ only when official evidence establishes a real geographic delivery territory that can be researched as a place.
Exclude PO-box/Postfach-only, company/institution-only without territory, branch, sorting/distribution-centre and other purely operational/non-geographic codes.

Use online-first verification through official Austrian postal, geographic and administrative sources; do not require bulk downloads unless online evidence is insufficient or a reproducible comparison is necessary.
Research and approve the national geographic-only PLZ inventory, documented exclusions and initial coverage order before populating this file.
The first content-production priority is major Austrian cities and nationally significant destinations, as agreed at project level.
